verdict.rationale: gstack skills ship as SKILL.md folders read from `.claude/skills/`, and the project documents support for many agent hosts (Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Kiro, OpenCode and others), so its skills do reach beyond one vendor. However, that portability comes from a generator with per-host TypeScript configs, not from one spec-conformant folder being valid as-is, and no evidence claims adherence to the open Agent Skills specification. missing for 10: explicit statement of Agent Skills spec conformance, evidence the same unmodified skill folder works across hosts, frontmatter/schema documentation, independent validation of cross-tool compatibility
